searchText: https://github.com/ethereum/ethereum-org-website/pull/5037/files Can I get some input on changes made in this PR 🙏 My understanding is that with cross-shard execution things like cross-shard account balance/smart contract are abstracted away — so with that in mind this change seems potentially misleading/confusing. things don't necessarily get abstracted away abstraction or not, they exist and dealing w/ them is a large part of complexity that drives us towards a simpler solution like "data sharding" and not having execution on the shards
